data.exact_reserve_text:
Partially offsetting the favourable premium variance in the period was an increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account, primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.
The year closed at a loss of GBP 64k following a calendar year profit of GBP 864k and a brought-forward retained loss after 24 months of GBP 928k. The result at 36 months follows the increase in incurred claims primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.

prior_year_events.impact_description: Increase in incurred claims on the 2015 year of account primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount; the year closed at a loss of GBP 64k following earlier calendar year profit and carried-forward loss movements.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2017 the Syndicate's opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2016) was GBP 0.906m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a small net gross release across underwriting years up to 2015 of approximately GBP 0.321m (about 35% of opening gross claims outstanding). Management notes an increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account driven by a higher average claim amount, and the 2015 year ultimately closed at a small loss on the 36month view.
raw_causal_phrases: Partially offsetting the favourable premium variance in the period was an increase in incurred claims particularly on the 2015 year of account, primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.
The year closed at a loss of GBP 64k following a calendar year profit of GBP 864k and a brought-forward retained loss after 24 months of GBP 928k.
The result at 36 months follows the increase in incurred claims primarily due to an increase in the average claim amount.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (gross) was not provided as a single explicit 'movement in prior year's provision' gross figure. The prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 29) comparing current estimates to the previous diagonal for underwriting years up to 2015 (excluded 2016 and 2017). Management commentary references increased incurred claims on the 2015 year of account (increase in average claim amount) which appears adverse for that year; however the triangle-derived aggregate across older years shows a small net gross release of c. GBP 0.321m. Life/long-term business mapping to the standard Lloyd's list uses 'Accident & Health' as the closest category; this mapping is approximate.
